d:
Late at night, delivery couriers suddenly drop off 30 large, mystery boxes at Jethalal’s house without giving any sender details. Terrified that they might contain explosives or illegal items, Jethalal alerts the police, prompting a midnight evacuation of Gokuldham Society and a full inspection with a sniffer dog named Romeo.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
